lede: Ulanzi makes gear for people who film and take photos: phone and camera tripods, small LED and RGB lights, camera cages, phone mounts and the Falcam F38 and F22 quick release systems. It sells on its own store at ulanzi.com, on Amazon and AliExpress. Here's who makes it, what the ratings say, what it costs and what the warranty and return rules say.

parts: Ulanzi is a real, established brand. Its store lists a business address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, its About page traces sales back to 2015, and it publishes shipping, return and warranty policies. Its best sellers are rated 4.7 to 4.9 out of 5 on its own product pages, and most of them cost $24 to $60. The two things to know before you buy: you have only 14 days to ask for a return and you pay return shipping unless the item is faulty, and some items ship from overseas in 10 to 12 business days.
On November 18, 2026, ulanzi.com sorted its range by how creators shoot. These are examples from each group with the price shown that day.

parts: Every best seller we checked sits between 4.7 and 4.9 out of 5, with 54 to 214 reviews each. Keep in mind that these ratings are shown by the store itself, and we couldn't check an independent rating on Trustpilot. The lowest score among the best sellers went to the MT85 pop-up phone tripod at 4.7.

What the store shows on the day you buy is worth a look too: on November 18, 2026, the MT-80 auto-open tripod was out of stock, and only 4 of the 11 options of the MA38 MagLock phone stand could be bought.

Yes. Ulanzi's About page says it led AliExpress's camera and photo category from 2015 to 2018, was sold in 70 countries by 2020, raised Series A+ funding in 2022, and now sells in more than 190 countries and regions with over 3,400 products and 600 patents. Those numbers come from Ulanzi itself. Its store gives a business address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, a service email, and support hours of 9:00 to 18:00 China time, Monday to Friday.
People also search for Ulanzi on Amazon and AliExpress. Ulanzi sells there too, but the code and the 4-year warranty on travel tripods apply only to orders on ulanzi.com.

For phone and small-camera shooters, the prices are low for what you get: the MT-44 tripod is $25.95, the MA30 phone tripod $24.99 and the VL49 RGB light $29.95. The F38 quick release kit is $29.95, a common way to start with quick release plates. At the top end, the Zero Y travel tripod is $279.95 and the Falcam TreeRoot $387, priced against other carbon fiber travel tripods.

The trade-offs are the return window and shipping. You have 14 days to ask for a return, you pay return shipping unless the item is faulty, and items that aren't stocked in the US or Germany take 10 to 12 business days. Check the model list on a mount or cage page before you buy, so it fits your phone or camera.

parts: Ulanzi suits phone vloggers, travelers and hobby photographers who want a light tripod, a small light or a quick release system without paying premium-brand prices, and creators who already use F38 plates. It's a poor fit if you want a long time to decide on a return, or if you need an item next week that isn't stocked in the US or Germany.

faq: Is Ulanzi legit?
Yes. Ulanzi has sold camera and phone gear since at least 2015, lists a business address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, and publishes shipping, return and warranty policies on ulanzi.com.
Is Ulanzi a good brand?
Its best sellers are rated 4.7 to 4.9 out of 5 on its own store, led by the MA30 phone tripod at 4.9 from 214 reviews on November 18, 2026. Those ratings come from the store's own review app.
Is Ulanzi a good tripod brand?
Its tripods rate well on its own store: the MT-44 at 4.9 from 54 reviews, the MT-16 at 4.8 from 68 and the Falcam TreeRoot travel tripod at 4.9 from 127. Prices run from $23.95 to $387.
Is Ulanzi worth it?
For most phone and small-camera shooters, yes: the MT-44 tripod is $25.95 and the VL49 light $29.95. Allow for a 14-day return window and return shipping you pay yourself.
What is Ulanzi's Trustpilot rating?
We couldn't check it on November 18, 2026: Trustpilot showed an access check to our browser. The ratings in this review come from Ulanzi's own product pages.
What does Ulanzi sell?
Phone and camera tripods, selfie sticks, LED and RGB lights, camera cages, phone mounts and grips, and the Falcam F38 and F22 quick release systems.
Where is Ulanzi based?
Its store lists a business address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, and support hours on China time (9:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday).
How long is the Ulanzi warranty?
One year for most products, and 4 years for five travel tripods bought on ulanzi.com, including the Zero Y and the Zero F38. Free gifts and clearance items aren't covered.
What is Ulanzi's return policy?
You can ask for a return within 14 days of receiving the product, unused and in its original packaging. Email Ulanzi for the return address first; you pay return shipping unless the item is faulty.
How long does Ulanzi shipping take?
Orders are processed in 1 to 2 business days. Items in US or German stock arrive in 3 to 4 business days, others in 10 to 12. Shipping is $5.99, free over $79.
